item.title: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi hits back with 2 wickets in 4 balls in Duleep Trophy - WATCH
item.summary: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi had faced only six balls and scored eight runs before being dismissed by North East Zone pacer Bishworjit Konthoujam in East Zone's first innings. But he responded with the ball, needing only eight deliveries to take his first wicket.
